principles: Skill and Tool remain separate: Skill teaches durable task behavior; Tool performs concrete operations; MCP is a discovery/transport surface, not semantic authority.
Tool-using Skills should bind or re-enter exact tool/version currentness when command/API drift can matter.
A Skill is advisory by default and cannot inherit Game, Research, Human-evidence, release or external-effect authority from installation, trust or popularity.
Prefer concise behavior-changing instructions; push volatile catalog/API details to discoverable tools or references.
Extract Skills from demonstrated workflows and failure modes, not from successful project prose alone.
